findings.title: TLS certificate trust or identity validation failed
findings.description: TLS certificate trust or identity validation failed
findings.evidence: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: self-signed certificate (_ssl.c:1029)
findings.impact: Clients cannot establish authenticated server identity.
findings.remediation: Install a valid certificate chain whose SAN matches the assessed address; lab self-signed certificates are expected exceptions.
findings.limitations: Verification can also fail due to missing local CA trust or lab-issued certificates.

methodology: Authorized IP-only TCP connect checks; passive banner sampling; HEAD / on known HTTP ports; verified TLS handshake plus clearly labeled untrusted certificate diagnostics.
limitations: Only configured ports and a single HTTP root response are checked. Service names are inferred from ports, not authenticated. No exploitation, CVE confirmation, weak-cipher enumeration, authentication, or subnet discovery. A clean scan does not establish system security.
source_note: Captured by record_demos.py against controlled loopback lab; not live.
